limits: All service JVMs run on one host with one shared Redis/MySQL; this does not represent cluster failover, cross-host partitions or storage data loss.
Public BFF clients still have no Refresh Token. RT uses an isolated confidential client and real Auth endpoints/internal caller proof with a 75-second cutoff, not a browser/public-client RT grant.
Dependency tests stop IAM/all Auth JVMs or pause Redis/MySQL while retaining data. They do not simulate arbitrary mid-command durability loss.

Self-signed same-origin HTTPS ignores certificate trust errors; customer CA, differential permissions, account-state matrix, audit persistence and coordinated deployment/rollback remain separate acceptance.
